aarti.tek: Om, victory to you, Mother Lakṣmī; Mother, victory to you, Mother Lakṣmī! Śiva, Viṣṇu and Brahmā serve you night and day.
aarti.pad1: You are Umā, Ramā and Brahmāṇī; you alone are the Mother of the world. The Sun and the Moon meditate on you, and the sage Nārada sings your praise. ॥1॥
aarti.pad2: You are Durgā in form, the stainless one, the giver of happiness and wealth. Whoever meditates on you gains prosperity, success and riches. ॥2॥
aarti.pad3: You dwell in the netherworld; you alone give what is good. You bring to light the effects of deeds, and you are the protector from the ocean of worldly existence. ॥3॥
aarti.pad4: In the house where you dwell, every virtue comes. Everything becomes possible there, and the heart is not troubled. ॥4॥
aarti.pad5: Without you no sacrifices are performed, and no one gets clothing. All the splendour of food and drink comes from you. ॥5॥
aarti.pad6: You are the beautiful temple of auspicious virtues, born of the ocean of milk. Without you no one gains the fourteen jewels. ॥6॥
aarti.pad7: Whoever sings the āratī of Mahālakṣmī finds his heart filled with joy, and his sins fall away. ॥7॥
